items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I did Ricky’s first record with Ozzie in the booth.

ctx.x: Oh, that’s great. It almost sounds like a little movie scene.

And ironically I did Ricky’s first record with Ozzie in the booth. And when Ricky did his first tune Ozzie turned to me and he said, “now you know how I felt about your writing.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

Because he didn’t know what Ricky was doing with the rock scene. I mean Ozzie was totally out of that you know. And he said that was the same feeling he had when that “Rasputin’s Laundry” came to this band.
